WEEK 39, 2026
24 September 2026

This is a weekly newsletter that lists newly announced training programs addressing existential risk from AI. Visit AISafety.com/training for the full directory of upcoming programs.

== NEW TRAINING PROGRAMS ==

* AI Safety Camp (AISC): 12th edition
  9 January – 26 April 2027 · Online · Fellowship
  3 months · Part-time · No stipend · Entry bar: low
  Applications to lead a project close 18 October
  Small teams work on concrete AI safety projects, each guided by a project lead who brings the idea and plan. Approaches include technical, governance, advocacy, and theoretical foundations work. General applications open 7 November.
  https://www.aisafety.camp/?utm_source=aisafety.com&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=events-training-newsletter

* Rethink Wellbeing: CBT Lab
  week of 16 November · Online · Course
  8 weeks · Part-time
  Apply by 5 October for priority, 25 October at the latest
  Mental health and productivity program. Groups of 4–6 people meet weekly with a facilitator to practice evidence-based tools for low energy, anxiety, imposter syndrome, and perfectionism. Free for people who have, or are working toward, a high positive impact through their career or donations – including in AI safety.
  https://www.rethinkwellbeing.org/services?utm_source=aisafety.com&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=events-training-newsletter

* Lens Academy: Alignment Theory of Deep Learning
  5–11 October · Online · Course
  1 week · Full-time · No stipend · Entry bar: mid
  Apply by 28 September
  Studies the mathematics behind why deep learning works and what it means for aligning the systems we train. Covers singular learning theory, training dynamics, and data attribution, drawn from the Iliad Intensive.
  https://lensacademy.org/courses/theory-of-deep-learning?utm_source=aisafety.com&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=events-training-newsletter

Full directory: https://aisafety.com/training?utm_source=training-newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=training-2026-week-39
